record_purpose: Provenance for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation ships no machine-readable API specification: it has no document in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0). The contract was therefore derived by reading the authoritative xAPIs reference published by Broadcom. Every page consulted is listed below.

sources.title: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Catalog
sources.documents: API landing page: category index and the OData-style collection conventions ($orderby, $top/$skip, page/size).

sources.title: Operations Index | VM Apps Org - Catalog
sources.documents: Full operation index; confirms the method + path of every catalog and deployment operation and the canonical per-operation page URLs.

sources.title: Catalog Items | VM Apps Org - Catalog
sources.documents: Catalog Items category page: the seven operations exposed under /catalog/api/items.

sources.title: Get Catalog Items (GET /catalog/api/items)
sources.documents: The paginated catalog item collection: query parameters page, size, sort, search, projects, types, expandProjects, expand, $top, $skip, $orderby; the Spring-style page envelope (content, empty, first, last, number, numberOfElements, pageable, size, sort, totalElements, totalPages); and the CatalogItem object fields.

sources.title: Get Catalog Item (GET /catalog/api/items/{id})
sources.documents: Single catalog item lookup: path parameter id, query parameters expandProjects and expand, bearerAuth scheme, and response codes 200 / 401 / 404.

sources.title: Get Deployments (GET /deployment/api/deployments)
sources.documents: Read only as a cross-check that the page/size envelope and array-parameter wording ('a comma-separated list') are consistent across VCF Automation collection endpoints. No operation from this page is part of the contract.

sources.title: VCF Automation OpenAPI | Provider Infrastructure APIs
sources.documents: Accept-header API versioning convention for VCF Automation ('application/json;version=9.1.0'), and the statement that a client may pin a version up to five majors back.
